t: Lesson 2, Setup. Your instructor is Patrick Diamitani.
Do this once and every task after it starts smarter.
Setup takes four steps. Install the Claude Desktop app.
Tell Claude about you in your instructions. Connect a work folder and check your memory settings.
Your instructions apply to every conversation. Say who you are and who you write for, how you like things written, and the formats you want back.
Next, connect a work folder. Claude can only see the folders you connect. It runs code in a separate, isolated sandbox, and it asks your permission before deleting anything.
Claude also has memory. Say remember that our launch is November 12th and it sticks. Say forget the old positioning doc and it's gone. You can view, edit, or pause memory anytime in settings.
Quick recap. Instructions, folders, and memory mean every task starts already briefed. Your mission, install the app, write your instructions, and connect one work folder.
Your setup. Next lesson, projects. One workspace per work stream. Learn, build, ship with LetsVibeAI
